title: Coordinate isolation versus selective aging: matched five-seed factorial
question: Does coordinate isolation recover causal prediction while global decay remains, or is entity-local aging required?
hypothesis: Write/read coordinate isolation may be sufficient under global decay; selective aging and their interaction are separately tested.
